changeSet.author: thereia
changeSet.comment: P2：路网表（静态数据，从 travel-bupt 导入）
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE route_node ( node_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, node_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'DESTINATION / INTERSECTION', building_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL, floor INT NULL, x_ratio DECIMAL(6,4) NOT NULL, y_ratio DECIMAL(6,4) NOT NULL, poi_category VARCHAR(32) NULL, enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (node_id), KEY idx_route_node_type (node_type) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT = '路网节点';
CREATE TABLE route_edge ( edge_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, from_node_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, to_node_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, distance_meters INT NOT NULL, time_seconds INT NOT NULL, edge_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'ROAD / STAIR / ELEVATOR', bike_allowed TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, congestion_factor DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.00, enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (edge_id), KEY idx_route_edge_from (from_node_id), KEY idx_route_edge_to (to_node_id) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT = '路网边';

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS route_edge; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS route_node;
